name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, where the parties fill in the business terms; it incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Standard Terms of the Common Paper Mutual NDA, letting each party share confidential information with the other for an agreed purpose.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper SLA covering uptime targets and support commitments; designed to be used with the Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper DPA governing how a provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for giving a design partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for providing professional services under statements of work (SOWs).

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement setting out the obligations and terms of a business partnership between two parties.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper BAA covering the handling of protected health information (PHI) by a business associate.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for licensing software to a customer.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper short-term agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a longer-term deal.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard addendum that adds terms for AI services, inputs and outputs to an existing agreement.
